title: Sexual Orientation
summary: Sexual orientation describes who you're romantically, emotionally or sexually attracted to — for example straight, gay, lesbian, bisexual, pansexual or asexual.
key_points: It isn't a choice and isn't caused by anything someone did.
Some people's orientation feels fixed; for others it shifts over time.
answer_guidance: Use respectful terms; let the user's own label stand.
